描述_EN: the partnership have designed ceramics for major producers and retailers around the globe. queensberry hunt are the leading uk ceramic design practice of the post-war period. these include wedgwood, hornsea, rosenthal, habitat, crate and barrel, john lewis and jamie oliver. their practice spans a period of immense change in the industry, brought about by the adoption of new technologies, and the shift in production towards east asia. formed in 1966 by david queensberry, then professor of ceramics at the rca, and his former student martin hunt. working in an essentially modernist aesthetic, queensberry hunt have been responsible for some of the most familiar and best-selling tableware of recent decades.
描述_ZN: 该伙伴关系为全球主要生产商和零售商设计陶瓷。 昆斯伯里-亨特是战后英国领先的陶瓷设计机构。 其中包括Wedgwood、Hornsea、Rosenthal、Habitat、Crate and Barrel、John Lewis和Jamie oliver。 他们的实践跨越了行业的巨大变化时期，由新技术的采用和生产向东亚的转移所带来的。 由David queensberry和他以前的学生Martin hunt于1966年成立，后者当时是RCA的陶瓷学教授。 在本质上的现代主义美学中工作，Queensberry Hunt负责近几十年来一些最熟悉和最畅销的餐具的制作。
